mLocKeys.keySummary: In human form, Nidalee lays a damaging trap for unwary opponents that, when sprung, reveals the target and reduces their Armor and Magic Resist for 12 seconds. As a cougar, she pounces forward, dealing a small amount of damage when she lands.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Cougar: Nidalee lunges forward, dealing @spell.Jade_NidaleeAspectOfTheCougar:TotalPounceDamage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Human: Nidalee lays a trap that deals @spell.Jade_NidaleeBushwhack:DamagePerSecond@ magic damage over 2 seconds, reveals the target, and shreds their Armor and Magic Resist by @spell.Jade_NidaleeBushwhack:ResistDecreases*100@% for 12 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Cougar: Nidalee lunges forward, dealing @spell.Jade_NidaleeAspectOfTheCougar:TotalPounceDamage@ magic damage to surrounding enemies.

Human: Nidalee lays a trap that deals @spell.Jade_NidaleeBushwhack:DamagePerSecond@ magic damage over 2 seconds, reveals the target, and shreds their Armor and Magic Resist by @spell.Jade_NidaleeBushwhack:ResistDecreases*100@% for 12 seconds. Traps last for 4 minutes.

mLocKeys.keySummary: In human form, Nidalee channels the spirit of the cougar to heal her allies and imbue them with attack speed for a short duration.  As a cougar, she rapidly claws enemies in front of her.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Cougar: Nidalee claws at enemies in front of her, dealing @spell.Jade_NidaleeAspectOfTheCougar:TotalSwipeDamage@ magic damage.

Human: Nidalee heals an allied champion for @spell.Jade_NidaleePrimalSurge:TotalHealing@ and grants them @spell.Jade_NidaleePrimalSurge:BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Cougar: Nidalee claws at enemies in front of her, dealing @spell.Jade_NidaleeAspectOfTheCougar:TotalSwipeDamage@ magic damage.

Human: Nidalee heals an allied champion for @spell.Jade_NidaleePrimalSurge:TotalHealing@ and grants them @spell.Jade_NidaleePrimalSurge:BonusAS*100@% Attack Speed for 7 seconds.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Times Brother Lee Sin Has Been Kicked: @f1@

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Prowl</titleLeft><mainText>Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Movement Speed by 15% for 2 seconds.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Moving through brush increases Nidalee's Movement Speed by 15% for 2 seconds.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: <mainText>Moving through brush increases Nidalee's <speed> Movement Speed by 15%</speed>  for 2 seconds.</mainText>

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Takedown</titleLeft><mainText>Nidalee's next basic attack will deal additional damage based on how much life the target is missing.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: In human form, Nidalee throws a spiked javelin at her target that gains damage as it flies.  As a cougar, her next attack will attempt to fatally wound her target, dealing more damage the less life they have.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Cougar: Nidalee's next attack deals @spell.Jade_NidaleeAspectOfTheCougar:TotalTakedownDamage@ physical damage, and the damage is increased against wounded targets (up to 300% total damage).

Human: Nidalee tosses her javelin, dealing between @spell.Jade_NidaleeJavelinToss:StartingDamage@ and @spell.Jade_NidaleeJavelinToss:MaxDamage@ magic damage on impact based on how far Nidalee is away from the target.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtended:
Cougar: Nidalee's next attack deals @spell.Jade_NidaleeAspectOfTheCougar:TotalTakedownDamage@ physical damage, and the damage is increased against wounded targets (up to 300% total damage).

Human: Nidalee tosses her javelin, dealing between @spell.Jade_NidaleeJavelinToss:StartingDamage@ and @spell.Jade_NidaleeJavelinToss:MaxDamage@ magic damage on impact based on how far Nidalee is away from the target.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Nidalee transforms into a cougar, gaining new abilities and increased Movement Speed.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Human: Nidalee transforms into a vicious cougar, gaining 20 Movement Speed, and her basic abilities become Takedown, Pounce, and Swipe.

Cougar: Nidalee transforms back into human form.
